facts.content: Patient has dry, itchy skin for a few days.
facts.source_text: CC: Dry, itchy skin x few days

facts.content: Patient has a pruritic, dry, erythematous rash on hands and arms that began after swimming.
facts.source_text: HPI: Pruritic, dry, erythematous rash on hands/arms; began after swimming

facts.content: Coconut butter was applied without providing relief.
No fever, sweating, spots, bleeding, or discharge on skin.
facts.source_text: No fever, no sweating, no spots; no bleeding/discharge from skin

facts.content: Appetite and oral intake are okay.
Bowels are normal.
No nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.
Urinating is okay but patient feels tired.
No prior skin problems like eczema or dermatitis.
Patient takes Microgynon, a combined oral contraceptive pill.
Patient uses coconut butter topically.
Possible lactose intolerance reported by the patient.
Father has asthma and mother has hayfever.
No family history of skin disease.
facts.source_text: no fam hx of skin disease

facts.content: Patient is a primary school teacher with increased work stress and long hours.
facts.source_text: Primary school teacher; ↑ work stress/long hours

facts.content: Patient lives alone, is a non-smoker, does not consume alcohol, and uses no recreational drugs.
facts.source_text: lives alone; nonsmoker; no etOH; no recreational drugs

facts.content: Suspected dermatitis with pruritic, dry, erythematous rash on hands and arms, onset after swimming, afebrile, and no systemic symptoms.
facts.source_text: Suspected dermatitis—pruritic, dry, erythematous rash of hands/arms; onset after swimming; afebrile; no systemic sx

facts.content: Provide dermatitis patient information leaflet.
Use emollients liberally throughout the day on affected areas.
facts.source_text: Emollients: liberal application to affected areas throughout day

facts.content: Apply topical steroid cream for inflammation.
Use over-the-counter antihistamines (Piriton or loratadine) as needed for itch.
facts.source_text: OTC antihistamines (Piriton or loratadine) prn itch

facts.content: Analgesics are not indicated.
Follow up next week if not improving; return sooner if there are concerns.
facts.source_text: F/u next week if not improving; return sooner if concerns
